svg.title: A walk from the question's entities
svg.desc: The graph after session 2, with only the facts still true in September. The question says 'my sister and her partner'; the entities whose names share a word with it are Anton's sister and Lena's partner Jonas, and both are ringed. Following edges from them for two steps reaches 'Lena is in a relationship with Jonas' and then 'Jonas has coeliac disease', drawn thick. The node Lena, which holds 'Lena cannot eat shellfish', is connected to nothing, so no walk reaches it. A table compares three ways of reading the same facts for the four facts the answer needs. Text search: the peanut allergy 10th, Lena's shellfish 4th, the new diet and Jonas's coeliac disease not returned. Text search then a walk from the entities those hits start at: the allergy 8th, shellfish 5th, the diet and coeliac not returned. A walk from the question's entities: only coeliac, 2nd.
svg.text: A walk from the question's entities
The question says “my sister and her partner”. Two stored entities share a word with it. Two steps along the edges from
them reach Jonas's coeliac disease, a fact that shares no word with the question and scores under the floor of the search.
The facts still true in September
an entity whose only fact has ended
THREE WAYS TO READ THE SAME FACTS
where each of the four facts the answer needs was placed
from where the hits start, up to 3
The shellfish fact is found only by text search, through the word “eat”: it hangs on the second node for Lena, which no walk reaches. The new diet
is one step from Anton, but so are eight other facts still true, and it is ranked behind them.
